text:
maya: Heads up — us-west shared-pool spiked again, avg queue depth on g4x nodes up to 78%, and looks like one tenant is generating lots of 20-50 token requests every 200ms. noisy-neighbor symptoms. :(
sre_jordan: Ugh. Which tenant id? any pattern on model/seq len?
maya: tenant: tc-42, mostly short chats hitting the chat endpoint with small completions. model v1-7b. seq len < 64. distribution: huge burstiness at 11:04-11:12.
vic: can we detect this automatically and apply smoothing? current soft-quota reacts too late.
nina: idea: compute per-tenant burst entropy over a sliding window and run a soft-admission policy when entropy>threshold. Treat high-entropy bursts as noisy-neighbor signals.
sre_jordan: I like entropy as a signal. Also add fast moving average of token-rate and request-count. combine both for score.
maya: quick POC: score = 0.6*norm(rate) + 0.4*norm(entropy). score>0.8 -> enter "burst_smoothing" mode for 30s. In smoothing mode we do per-request probability drop or delay.
vic: can we avoid outright drops? prefer smoothing with token-bucket shaping + queue-priority demotion. slow down the noisy tenant without increasing tail latency for others.
nina: agreed. config sketch:
```
admission_policy: {
  "type": "hybrid",
  "scoring": {"rate_weight": 0.6, "entropy_weight": 0.4, "window_s": 60},
  "smoothing": {
    "mode": "token_bucket",
    "rate_per_sec": 8,
    "burst": 40,
    "demote_priority": "background",
    "max_smoothing_s": 30
  }
}
```
vic: implementation notes: token counters in Redis per tenant keyed by region/pool. keep TTL short so we don't hold memory. need to ensure cross-region tenant affinity respects private deployments.
sre_jordan: watch out for racey increments when we run on many coordinators; use INCR and Lua to atomically read tokens. Redis cost impact might be ~0.5-1c/hr per 10k tenants in worst case — low but worth noting.
maya: also need a fast path: if pool-level utilization < 60% skip scoring to avoid extra RPCs.
opsbot: Alert suppression triggered for tc-42 from 11:12 to 11:16 (reason: suspicious burst detected)
vic: rollout plan: 1) implement scoring and local dry-run logs for 48h across canary region us-west-2; 2) enable smoothing in canary with very gentle rates (rate_per_sec=4) for 24h; 3) incrementally increase and expand to other regions.
nina: metrics to watch: per-tenant tail P95 latency for others, queue-depth heatmap, token-rate distribution, and redis op latency. Add an eval to replay a day's traffic and verify quality degradation <1% of completions changed.
sre_jordan: canary tonight after 22:00 PDT? I can shepherd. maya — can you prepare a rule + kibana dashboard?
maya: yes, I'll add logs and dashboard. also will add a flag to opt tenants out if enterprise requests it.
vic: long-term: consider per-tenant credits and a latent penalty that decays slower for repeat offenders. Also expose a usage breakdown so customers can self-diagnose.

sre_jordan: thanks. I'll monitor and post a short summary after 2h. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all. if we see any false positives we'll revert smoothing and iterate. :thinking:
